body: Do you still have the crash logs? I'd be interested in seeing the lines 1 - 7 which are omitted.

> Do you still have the crash logs? I'd be interested in seeing the lines 1 - 7 which are omitted.

I've edited the body of the issue to include the crash log that I had omitted.

Cannot reproduce on 

> Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9227) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 31.34 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

Godot doesn't generate the `.godot/editor/editor_script_doc_cache.res` for me, only on the first import. It didn't crash once for me.

But the function that crashes is very simple

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4173760fdf6c2c722e82e08cb58e55f34c9efd80/editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp#L97-L101

so if I had to guess `files[p_idx]` or `files[p_idx]->file` is null and Windows isn't as strict about memory safety as macOS/Linux.

This error appeared once:

```
ERROR: FATAL: Index p_index = 4 is out of bounds (size() = 0).
   at: CowData<struct EditorFileSystemDirectory::FileInfo *>::get (.\core/templates/cowdata.h:199)
```

I hit this race on Linux **with `--headless`**, so headless doesn't avoid it here. It takes a different path, though: the regeneration thread is handed a null `EditorFileSystemDirectory` rather than a freed one.

- **Version:** v4.7.2.stable.arch_linux [ed1daf0bf], both the standard and the .NET build
- **OS:** Arch Linux, x86_64
- **Command:** `godot --headless --import --path <project>`

It's intermittent. Over about three weeks of automated imports on one machine (test suites, CI, several projects at once) it crashed a couple of hundred times, with exit code 134. I couldn't trigger it on demand: more than 70 manual runs, including 8 at a time, all exited 0. The console shows `Parameter "singleton" is null` from `EditorNode::is_cmdline_mode` before the crash.

The crashing thread, from a core dump symbolized through debuginfod:

```
#4  handle_crash (sig=<optimized out>) at platform/linuxbsd/crash_handler_linuxbsd.cpp:247
#5  <signal handler called>
#6  CowData<EditorFileSystemDirectory*>::size (this=0x160) at ./core/templates/cowdata.h:174
#7  Vector<EditorFileSystemDirectory*>::size (this=0x158) at ./core/templates/vector.h:92
#8  EditorFileSystemDirectory::get_subdir_count (this=0x0) at editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:88
#9  EditorHelp::_reload_scripts_documentation (p_dir=p_dir@entry=0x0) at editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3212
#10 EditorHelp::_regen_script_doc_thread (p_udata=<optimized out>) at editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3203
#11 Thread::callback (..., p_callback=<EditorHelp::_regen_script_doc_thread(void*)>, p_userdata=0x0) at core/os/thread.cpp:64
```

The main thread at the same moment, already deep in `Main::cleanup`:

```
#7  Thread::wait_to_finish () at core/os/thread.cpp:86
#8  CameraLinux::~CameraLinux () at modules/camera/camera_linux.cpp:186
#9  memdelete<CameraServer> () at ./core/os/memory.h:163
#11 Main::cleanup () at main/main.cpp:5333
#12 main () at platform/linuxbsd/godot_linuxbsd.cpp:126
```

Reading 4.7.2-stable, this is the path I believe it takes:

1. On `NOTIFICATION_POSTINITIALIZE`, `EditorNode` calls `EditorHelp::generate_doc()`. Its worker thread (`_load_doc_thread` or `_gen_doc_thread`) ends by queuing `load_script_doc_cache()` with `call_deferred()`.
2. If the import finishes before the main loop runs that call, `OS_LinuxBSD::run()` calls `main_loop->finalize()`, and `SceneTree::finalize()` deletes the root. `~EditorNode` waits for the doc thread in `cleanup_doc()` and then sets `singleton = nullptr`. `EditorFileSystem` has left the tree by then, which frees `filesystem` and sets it to `nullptr`.
3. `Main::cleanup()` begins with `message_queue->flush()`, which runs the queued `load_script_doc_cache()`. There, `EditorNode::is_cmdline_mode()` hits `ERR_FAIL_NULL_V(singleton, false)` and returns `false`, so the early return for command-line mode is skipped. A headless run never saves a script doc cache, so it calls `regenerate_script_doc_cache()`. Nothing is scanning, so that calls `loader_thread.start(_regen_script_doc_thread, EditorFileSystem::get_singleton()->get_filesystem())` with a null tree. The new thread dereferences it while the main thread carries on through `Main::cleanup`, and the crash handler turns the segfault into an abort (134).

A guard in `load_script_doc_cache()` and `regenerate_script_doc_cache()` that returns when `EditorNode::get_singleton()` or `EditorFileSystem::get_singleton()->get_filesystem()` is null would close this path. The non-headless crash in the original report, which reads a tree freed underneath it, may need its own fix: the regeneration thread joined (or never started) before `EditorFileSystem` frees its tree.
